what: The four Cottonwood Canyons resorts and Palisades Tahoe: forecast point, snow sensor, NWS grid, time zone, opening day and live cams

sources.base_peak_ft: Ski Utah resort pages, statistics (skiutah.com/resorts/<name>), read 2026-10-29. Palisades Tahoe: the resort's mountain statistics page, Olympic Valley side (palisadestahoe.com/footer/mountain-statistics), read 2026-11-13
sources.point: Alta: the original forecast point (40.5884, -111.6386, 9,895 ft). Others: on the resort's OpenStreetMap ski-area outline (ways 1023308078, 682230007, 682230006; Palisades Tahoe: relation 13336421, the Olympic Valley side), at the height halfway between its base and peak (AWS Terrain Tiles, Terrarium z13), nearest the outline's centre
sources.snotel: NRCS AWDB station list, nearest active SNOTEL; Solitude has none of its own, so it uses Brighton's, 2.4 km east
sources.tz: api.weather.gov/points/<lat>,<lon> (timeZone); a resort without one is on America/Denver
sources.opening: Ski Utah, '2026–27 Utah Ski Resort Opening Dates' (Oct 1, 2026), skiutah.com/blog/authors/yeti/utah-ski-resort-opening-dates/. Palisades Tahoe: ABC7 News, 'LIST: Tahoe ski resorts 2026-27 opening dates' (Aug 20, 2026), abc7news.com/post/list-tahoe-ski-resorts-2026-27-opening-dates/19704870/
sources.logo: The resort's own site icon (apple-touch-icon or header logo), read 2026-11-01 (Palisades Tahoe 2026-11-13). Trademarks of each resort, so the files stay out of the repo (logos/ is git-ignored); without them the app shows initials
sources.cams: Each resort's own webcam page, read 2026-10-29 (Palisades Tahoe 2026-11-13). Brighton and Solitude publish their cams as YouTube live streams (titles from YouTube oEmbed); Alta's, Snowbird's and Palisades Tahoe's are pictures on their own sites, so the app links to those pages

cams.label: Alta's cams: snow stake (cleared 4 am and 4 pm), Baldy, Superior, Sugarloaf, Albion
Snowbird's snow stake cam, plus Hidden Peak and the rest on its webcam page
All of Palisades Tahoe's cams, Olympic Valley and Alpine Meadows
